July 2026 Forfait 2€ is €2/month recurring plus a €10 SIM/eSIM fee; eligible Freebox users may have one €0/month line. No prepaid inactivity renewal clock.
France residence/stable link required; Free store asks for RIB and 3D Secure card; foreign-only subscription unverified.
Free eSIM QR/app installation and France physical terminals documented; exact new €2 first eSIM activation while in China unverified.
Outside Europe/DOM Forfait 2€ requires prior Option Voyage and a one-time €10 usage advance; not another recurring fee.
Provider inbound roaming SMS free if attached; current China outgoing SMS €0.27 and data €9.70/MB do not prove bank/OTP delivery.
SMS sent while overseas continue over cellular despite VoWiFi support.

data.acquisitionSummary: Forfait 2€ is a €2/month recurring contract (not prepaid inactivity retention). The current SIM/eSIM charge is €10 at signup; €10 here is SIM-only acquisition, excluding the first monthly bill and any later Option Voyage advance. Free supports physical SIM terminals in France; foreign first subscription remains unverified.

keep.action: Keep paying the recurring €2/month contract (€24 for twelve months of subscription), not a prepaid top-up or chargeable-SMS inactivity clock. The optional €10 Voyage advance is one-time prepaid usage balance, not an annual subscription charge.

data.chinaActivation: New Forfait 2€ SIM/eSIM first activation from mainland China is not verified. Official eSIM QR/app installation exists, and physical SIM terminals are in France; eligible metropolitan-France residence/stable-link status is still required.
data.kyc: Forfait 2€ is reserved to people living in metropolitan France or proving a stable link to it. Online signup needs accurate subscriber details and email; a Free store asks for RIB and 3D Secure bank card. An offshore-only verification path for foreign applicants is unproven.
data.payment: €10 SIM/eSIM fee payable by card during enrollment. A Free boutique asks for RIB and 3D Secure-compatible card; foreign IBAN, foreign-card and foreign-address subscription acceptance are not established. Outside Europe/DOM the separate Option Voyage requires a one-time €10 consumption advance paid by card.
data.wifiCalling: VoWiFi is supported on compatible devices, but Free says overseas outgoing SMS continue over the cellular network; do not claim Wi-Fi fixes China SMS/OTP roaming.
data.roamingSms: Free states that inbound roaming SMS are free if the line connects. For Forfait 2€ outside Europe/DOM, Option Voyage requires advance activation and a one-time €10 consumption advance. July 2026 brochure China row: outgoing SMS €0.27 and data €9.70/MB, not a guarantee of China network attachment or particular bank/app OTP.
data.refund: Free calls the €10 Option Voyage prepayment an advance on usage; refund of unused credit was not established.
data.holdReason: Residence/stable-link France eligibility; uncertain foreign checkout/card/eSIM activation, China roaming partner and bank/app OTP. A 2023 Asian SMS success and a 2025 African SMS failure are non-China, non-app-isolated reports.
data.tariffSummary: €2/month recurring plan (€24/12 months) + €10 SIM/eSIM fee, eligible Freebox €0/month exception; outside-Europe Option Voyage distinct €10 prepaid usage advance. China sending SMS €0.27, mobile data €9.70/MB; incoming roaming SMS provider-free but China app OTP unknown.
